# evroc_public_ip (Data Source)

Get information about an existing evroc public IP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the public IP to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the public IP is allocated.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the public IP was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) The allocated IPv4 address.
- `ip_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the public IP.
